invalid_trials: A '10-bit' start that reran the 12-bit binary because ninja did not rebuild after a host-side copy (touch inside the container is needed)

after_removal.user_report: SD film at 1080p25 first looked full of green specks and stuttering while the player reported zero drops; after a media-service restart it was stable and smooth but with green specks
after_removal.interpretation: Unproven. Router-readable state was identical before and after the restart. Specks in the film's early dark scenes are expected to some degree: the r7 shader left about 27 % of them in simulation.

apple_tv_cross_check: User: an Apple TV 4K on the same TV plays 4K HDR and Dolby Vision without problems. Whether it uses the same HDMI port and cable was not established. This points the unresolved 4K flicker at the router's 4K output path rather than the TV.
